metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a dependency-free BibTeX 0.99c-style CLI in Node.js.

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (run as `node output/main.js --bib … --style … --cites … --output … [--log …]`)
- Core pieces:
  - `.bst` tokenizer/parser + load-time validation: `output/src/bst/parser.js`
  - `.bib` scanner/parser with `@string`, `@preamble`, macro expansion, `crossref` inheritance + warnings: `output/src/bib/parser.js`
  - `.bst` stack-machine runtime + built-ins + metrics: `output/src/engine/runtime.js`
  - BibTeX-compatible name formatting (`format.name$`, `num.names$`) and TeX string ops (`purify$`, `change.case$`, `width$`, `text.length$`, `text.prefix$`): `output/src/engine/name.js`, `output/src/engine/tex.js`
  - 79-column `.bbl` wrapping and newline behavior: `output/src/engine/outputBuffer.js`
  - Cite-key ingestion (`--cites`, `--aux`) + dedupe: `output/src/cites.js`
- Output contract:
  - Exit `0`: `--output` is the generated `.bbl` (UTF-8, LF)
  - Exit `1`: `--output` is error JSON (`source` = `bib`/`bst`/`runtime`) plus `warnings`
  - Optional `--log`: always written as structured JSON with counts + `warnings`
